     # default ignore list for detailed views
     IGNORE = ('module', 'docuri', 'version_added', 'short_description', 'now_date', 'plainexamples', 'returndocs', 'collection')
 
+    @classmethod
+    def tty_ify(cls, text):
+        def replace(match):
+            macro = match.group(1) or match.group(3)
+            if macro is None:
+                return '\n-------------\n'
+
+            value = match.group(2) if match.group(1) else match.group(4)
+            if macro in ('I', 'C'):
+                return "`%s'" % value
+            if macro == 'B':
+                return '*%s*' % value
+            if macro == 'M':
+                return '[%s]' % value
+            if macro == 'L':
+                return '%s <%s>' % (value, match.group(5))
+            return value
+
+        return _TTY_MACRO.sub(replace, text)

+# Copyright: (c) 2026, Ansible Project
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+import pytest
+
+from ansible.cli.doc import DocCLI
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('source, expected', [
+    ('L(text,https://example.org)', 'text <https://example.org>'),
+    ('L(text, https://example.org)', 'text <https://example.org>'),
+    ('R(text,reference)', 'text'),
+    ('R(text, reference)', 'text'),
+    ('HORIZONTALLINE', '\n-------------\n'),
+    ('I(italic) B(bold) M(module) U(url) C(constant)', "`italic' *bold* [module] url `constant'"),
+    ('Use M(name), B(text), C(value), and R(title,ref).', "Use [name], *text*, `value', and title."),
+    ('IBM(International Business Machines) and F(example)', 'IBM(International Business Machines) and F(example)'),
+    ('preM(name) and HORIZONTALLINEsuffix', 'preM(name) and HORIZONTALLINEsuffix'),
+])
+def test_tty_ify(source, expected):
+    assert DocCLI.tty_ify(source) == expected
